Markets: In freefall. AI industry set to spend $1.4 trillion next year, Goldman Sachs says.

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.title: Madison Huang, Jensen Huang’s Daughter, Became a Powerful Force at Nvidia
sources.description: Installed as her father’s de facto chief of staff, Jensen Huang’s daughter alienated top executives. Now her lingering role poses a test for interim C.E.O. Colette Kress.
